name: quran-epub-builder
description: Builds two polished Mushaf-style EPUB 3 files (Arabic-only Uthmani, and Indonesian Kemenag) from the quran.com API v4.

scripts.build:clara-image: python build-clara-image-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/pdf/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara.pdf" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Gambar).epub" "Al-Qur'an al-Karim" 0 1072 2
scripts.build:clara: npm run build:clara-pdf && npm run build:clara-image
scripts.build:dzikir-clara: node build-epub-pdf.js dzikir clara042 && python build-clara-image-epub.py "dist/Dzikir Pagi Petang/pdf/Universal/Dzikir Pagi dan Petang.pdf" "dist/Dzikir Pagi Petang/epub/Kobo-Clara/Dzikir Pagi dan Petang (Gambar).epub" "Dzikir Pagi dan Petang" 0 1072 2 coverjpeg
scripts.build:juzamma-clara: node build-epub-pdf.js juzamma && python build-clara-image-epub.py "dist/Juz Amma/pdf/Universal/Juz 'Amma & Terjemahan.pdf" "dist/Juz Amma/epub/Kobo-Clara/Juz Amma & Terjemahan (Gambar).epub" "Juz 'Amma & Terjemahan" 0 1072 2 coverjpeg
scripts.build:terjemah-x4: node builder.js --offline --only=indo && node build-epub-pdf.js terjemah x4
scripts.build:terjemah-clara: node build-epub-pdf.js terjemah && python build-clara-image-epub.py "dist/Al Quran dan Terjemahnya (Bahasa Indonesia)/pdf/Kobo-Clara/Al Quran dan Terjemahnya (Clara).pdf" "dist/Al Quran dan Terjemahnya (Bahasa Indonesia)/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al Quran dan Terjemahnya (Gambar).epub" "Al-Qur'an dan Terjemahnya" 0 1072 2 coverjpeg
scripts.build:clara-text: python build-kobo-clara-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Universal/Al-Quran (IndoPak Format).epub" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Teks).epub" --swap ScheherazadeNew-Regular.ttf assets/fonts/LPMQ-IsepMisbah.ttf --x4-style --ayah-ornament --canonical-marks
scripts.build:clara-text-amiri: python build-kobo-clara-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Universal/Al-Quran (IndoPak Format).epub" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Teks Amiri).epub" --swap ScheherazadeNew-Regular.ttf assets/fonts/AmiriQuran-Regular.ttf --x4-style --canonical-marks
